Глюкозамин + хондроитин.about: Cartilage substrates for osteoarthritis; the effect is small, close to placebo; chondroitin is a little stronger.
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.caution: CHONDROITIN works better than glucosamine. The effect is small but clinically significant (NNT=5). RCT quality is mostly LOW. Glucosamine sulfate works better than hydrochloride. There were fewer serious adverse events than placebo (Peto OR 0.40).
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.food_sources: Bone broths, cartilage, shrimp; You can’t get working doses from food - it’s easier to take a supplement.
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.guidelines: 2025 SR (safety): profile acceptable; 2023 MA (knee): chondroitin - short-term benefit, glucosamine ≈ placebo (except Rotta).
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.how_to_choose: Chondroitin 1200 mg or glucosamine sulfate 1500 mg (not hydrochloride); course 3–6 months; no effect - quit.

interactions.note: may enhance the effect, INR control

mechs: Cartilage matrix substrate; MA are inconsistent
Chondroitin: short-term effect on OA pain
Pain in the first 6 months is lower (10%); long-term effects without confirmation (43 RCT)
VAS is marginally lower; WOMAC is insignificant, only the Rotta drug is better (20 RCT to 2005)
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.myths: “Restores cartilage” - regeneration has not been proven in RCT. “Acts like ibuprofen” - the effect is small and close to placebo, wears off after a year.
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.name: Glucosamine + Chondroitin
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.onset: Course effect: pain is lower in the first 6 months, by the year the effect wears off (43 RCT).
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.title: Glucosamine + Chondroitin
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.upper_limit: No formal UL listed - no toxicity data available.
Глюкозамин + хондроитин.who_needs: Knee arthrosis: modest pain relief in the first months; in case of severe wear and tear and obesity, it is not a replacement for treatment.
